# house_pricing_nbdev


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

## What it does

`house_pricing_nbdev` software converts the ames housing workflow in
into a package API. It includes the selected feature set, feature-engine
preprocessing, custom sklearn-compatible transformers, Lasso price
modeling, evaluation helpers, Kaggle-style submission creation, and
model persistence.

## Installation

Install in development mode from the repository root:

``` sh
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

Then export and test notebook changes with:

``` sh
nbdev-export
nbdev-test
nbdev-prepare
```

## Quick start

Load the included training data from `script/train.csv`:

``` python
train = load_housing_data()
train.shape
```

Build the same end-to-end pipeline used by the original source notebook:

``` python
pipeline = build_price_pipeline()
pipeline.steps[-1][0]
```

Train and evaluate the model:

``` python
result = train_price_model()
result.metrics
```

Create predictions for the included Kaggle-style test file:

``` python
submission = make_submission(result.model)
submission.head()
```

Save and reload a fitted model:

``` python
model_path = save_model(result.model, "models/price_pipe.joblib")
model = load_model(model_path)
```
